name: Meditation Realm
description: The Meditation Realm is a shifting realm that reshapes itself to those who perceive it, and a hub of reality that served as Ugin's prison for Bolas.

description_citations.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 5: Recursion" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Mar 2025.

citations.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 5: Recursion" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Mar 2025.

bio.text: Jace said they were trapped in it, and Narset told her companions to empty their minds so the realm would stop fighting.

citations.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 7: Return" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Mar 2025.

bio.text: Later, in the Meditation Realm, Jace learned to transform an illusion into something real.

citations.text: "The Legends of Reality Fracture" by Meris Mullaley, Christopher Stuart-Reckling, K. Arsenault Rivera, DK Billins. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Sep 2026.

status.text: The realm burned away into nothing, though a later story shows Jace learning to make illusions real in it.

citations.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 7: Return" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Mar 2025.
"The Legends of Reality Fracture" by Meris Mullaley, Christopher Stuart-Reckling, K. Arsenault Rivera, DK Billins. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: Tetsuo Umezawa defeats and kills Bolas on the Meditation Plane.
timeline.quote: Bolas was defeated and killed by Umezawa.

citation.text: "Nicol Bolas", section "Madaran Emperor". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan takes a hedron chunk to Bolas's Meditation Realm, where Bolas reveals he meant to free the Eldrazi all along.
timeline.quote: Bolas reveals he intended to free the Eldrazi all along

citation.text: "Sarkhan Vol", section "The Eye of Ugin". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Bolas kills Ugin on the Meditation Plane.
timeline.quote: they returned to the Meditation Realm, where Bolas killed Ugin

citation.text: "Nicol Bolas", section "Confrontation on the Meditation Plane". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ugin strips Bolas of both his names and imprisons him in the Meditation Realm.
timeline.quote: Ugin then informed Bolas that he had lost the use of both his names so that he couldn't be summoned by another being ever again.

citation.text: "Nicol Bolas", section "Nameless and imprisoned". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ugin becomes Bolas's jailer for the rest of his mortal life.
timeline.quote: Ugin told his brother that he'd become his jailer for the remainder of Bolas's mortal life

citation.text: "Nicol Bolas", section "Nameless and imprisoned". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan helps Ugin bypass Bolas's wards and retrieves Niv's ghost box for the Meditation Realm.
timeline.quote: He delivered the " ghost box" to the Meditation Realm

citation.text: "Sarkhan Vol", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Bolas kills Ugin, finds the Spirit-Gem in the Meditation Realm and claims it, wearing it for millennia.
timeline.quote: Bolas found the gem in the Meditation Realm after killing his brother Ugin

citation.text: "Spirit-Gem", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jace and Vraska reach the Meditation Plane through an Omenpath and meet Narset and Elspeth.
timeline.quote: they were met by Narset and Elspeth Tirel who had followed a lead to find a solution to the increasing dragonstorms

citation.text: "Spirit-Gem", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: They meet the sealed elder dragons; Ugin berates Jace while the nameless dragon that had been Bolas looks for an opportunity.
timeline.quote: the nameless dragon that had been Nicol Bolas saw a chance to gain information and regain power.

citation.text: "Spirit-Gem", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jace secretly steals the Spirit-Gem from behind Ugin and casts a reality-altering spell.
timeline.quote: He secretly moved behind Ugin's back and stole the Spirit-Gem.

citation.text: "Spirit-Gem", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Elspeth attacks Bolas, thinking Jace will offer him the Gem, and Vraska tries to hold Jace back.
timeline.quote: Thinking that he would offer the Gem to Bolas, Elspeth attacked and temporarily distracted him.

citation.text: "Spirit-Gem", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jace's endurance fails and reality breaks into a void that unmakes him; he shatters like glass.
timeline.quote: As the emptiness rolled over him, he shattered like glass.

citation.text: "Spirit-Gem", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ugin takes Bolas' body to the Meditation Realm and has Jace create an illusion of the corpse disintegrating.
timeline.quote: Ugin arrives to bring Bolas' body to the Meditation Realm to prevent him from coming back to life on Ravnica.

citation.text: "War of the Spark (event)", section "Act 3". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Months later Bolas is reborn in the Meditation Realm completely powerless.
timeline.quote: Months later, Bolas is reborn in the Meditation Realm but finds himself completely powerless

citation.text: "War of the Spark (event)", section "Epilogue". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ugin reveals he orchestrated Bolas' defeat with Niv-Mizzet and Sarkhan, and merges with the Meditation Realm, sealing it with Bolas inside.
timeline.quote: Ugin expands himself throughout the plane, revealing that he's merged his essence with the Meditation Realm.

citation.text: "War of the Spark (event)", section "Epilogue". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Decades later Vaash Vroga loses control of Leshrac's mantle and his spirit emerges and departs.
timeline.quote: Stating that "the tether is complete", Leshrac's spirit emerged from the mantle and departed.

citation.text: "Leshrac", section "Magic: Legends". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The planeswalker activates the pocket realm's aetheric core, confirming Ral's suspicion.
timeline.quote: Ral's suspicion was confirmed when the planeswalker activated the pocket realm's aetheric core simply by mentally focusing on it.

citation.text: "The Traveler", section "The Traveler's Realm". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Elspeth's attack unwittingly lets Bolas remember his name.
timeline.quote: Elspeth assumed that he was in league with Bolas and attacked, unwittingly allowing the dragon to remember his name.

citation.text: "Nicol Bolas", section "Rediscovered". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Meditation Realm collapses, erasing Jace, and Bolas escapes into the Multiverse.
timeline.quote: Taking advantage of the confusion, Bolas evaded his brother and escaped into the Multiverse.

citation.text: "Nicol Bolas", section "Rediscovered". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Elspeth and Narset find Jace in the Meditation Realm; Jace steals the Spirit-Gem, fails and seemingly dies, and Nicol Bolas escapes.
timeline.quote: He fails and seemingly dies, and Nicol Bolas escapes in the process.

citation.text: "Tarkir/Timeline", section "Phyrexian Invasion and Reconstruction". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Elspeth sees endless water while Narset sees stairs, and they realize this Meditation Realm is a distraction hiding something.
timeline.quote: The Meditation Realm. I've been here before.

citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 5: Recursion" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Mar 2025.

timeline.summary: Narset hears a weeping voice whispering a name, and Jace Beleren appears.
timeline.quote: Jace Beleren stood on a rime of white sand

citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 5: Recursion" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Mar 2025.

timeline.summary: Jace reveals he escaped compleation by force of will, and Narset theorizes how.
timeline.quote: I was on my way to that, yes. But I am not anymore.

citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 5: Recursion" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Mar 2025.

timeline.summary: Jace introduces Loot, a creature whose mind holds a map of every Omenpath, and Narset questions whether Loot consented to this state.
timeline.quote: He is a map of everything .

citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 5: Recursion" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Mar 2025.

timeline.summary: Jace evades Elspeth's question, saying he did what he needed to.
timeline.quote: What I needed to.

citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 5: Recursion" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Mar 2025.

timeline.summary: In the present, Jace says they are trapped in the Meditation Realm, and Narset tells her companions to empty their minds so the realm stops fighting.
timeline.quote: It's our thoughts that are trapping us in this shifting space.

citation.work: Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 6: How Wretched Love
citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 6: How Wretched Love" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Mar 2025.

timeline.summary: The realm reveals Ugin and a chained dragon together.
timeline.quote: revealing two figures that Narset would have known even in death

citation.work: Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 6: How Wretched Love
citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 6: How Wretched Love" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Mar 2025.

timeline.summary: Ugin warns them away, and Bolas, who has lost his memories, says he recognizes the three and calls Jace an accomplice.
timeline.quote: That you, perhaps, were an accomplice

citation.work: Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 6: How Wretched Love
citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 6: How Wretched Love" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Mar 2025.

timeline.summary: Ugin explains that he has made the realm a prison for his brother, to be kept until Bolas dies millennia from now.
timeline.quote: So, I have made this our prison

citation.work: Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 6: How Wretched Love
citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 6: How Wretched Love" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Mar 2025.

timeline.summary: Narset asks Ugin for help against the dragonstorms and he says he cannot.
timeline.quote: I am sorry, but there is nothing I can do.

citation.work: Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 6: How Wretched Love
citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 6: How Wretched Love" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Mar 2025.

timeline.summary: Bolas learns his name from Elspeth's argument and begins to remember.
timeline.quote: Is that my name?

citation.work: Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 6: How Wretched Love
citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 6: How Wretched Love" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Mar 2025.

timeline.summary: Jace, who has already shifted to an illusory double, seizes the gem between Ugin's horns and an explosion of light follows.
timeline.quote: Jace closed his hands over the gleaming jewel suspended between Ugin's horns

citation.work: Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 6: How Wretched Love
citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 6: How Wretched Love" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Mar 2025.

timeline.summary: Jace reveals he wants to reverse Phyrexia's damage and control the realm; Elspeth attacks him and Narset protects her.
timeline.quote: What if I say that I can reverse everything?

citation.work: Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 6: How Wretched Love
citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 6: How Wretched Love" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Mar 2025.

timeline.summary: Narset rescues the terrified Loot as Elspeth fights Jace.
timeline.quote: I've got you,

citation.work: Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 6: How Wretched Love
citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 6: How Wretched Love" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Mar 2025.

timeline.summary: Jace explains the realm is a hub of reality that he can mold by will, to save Vraska from what Phyrexia did.
timeline.quote: This place is a substrate to all of reality, touching countless worlds and moldable by sheer force of will.

citation.work: Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 6: How Wretched Love
citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 6: How Wretched Love" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Mar 2025.

timeline.summary: Vraska appears, changed and grief-worn, and tells Jace to stop.
timeline.quote: It was Vraska herself.

citation.work: Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 6: How Wretched Love
citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 6: How Wretched Love" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Mar 2025.

timeline.summary: Jace, wielding the stolen power, shows glimpses of lost futures, but the strain breaks him and the realm begins to unmake itself.
timeline.quote: revealing a nothingness that ate at the eye

citation.work: Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 6: How Wretched Love
citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 6: How Wretched Love" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Mar 2025.

timeline.summary: Jace shatters like glass as emptiness rolls over him, and Elspeth tells Narset to run.
timeline.quote: As the emptiness rolled over him, he shattered like glass.

citation.work: Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 6: How Wretched Love
citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 6: How Wretched Love" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Mar 2025.

timeline.summary: Narset carries Loot as they flee.
timeline.quote: Narset, a wailing Loot in her arms, did as she was told.

citation.work: Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 6: How Wretched Love
citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 6: How Wretched Love" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Mar 2025.

timeline.summary: Bolas laughs as his fetters come undone and he and Ugin vanish into the nothing as the Meditation Realm burns away.
timeline.quote: Bolas and Ugin winking out of existence, eaten by the nothing, dead now, perhaps.

citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 7: Return" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Mar 2025.

timeline.summary: Elspeth and Narset encounter Jace, Loot, Ugin and Bolas in the Meditation Realm.
timeline.quote: they encountered Jace Beleren and the creature Loot

citation.text: "Dragonstorm (phenomenon)", section "Ending the outbreaks". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jace's reality-bending spell fails and he shatters like glass as the Realm unmakes itself.
timeline.quote: he shattered like glass.

citation.text: "Dragonstorm (phenomenon)", section "Ending the outbreaks". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Narset and Elspeth find a temple housing an Omenpath to the Meditation Realm and meet Jace and Loot.
timeline.quote: they happened on Jace Beleren and the creature Loot

citation.text: "Narset", section "Searching for answers". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Narset empties her mind so the Realm takes true form, revealing the two sealed elder dragons.
timeline.quote: used a meditative technique to empty her mind, allowing the plane to assume its true form

citation.text: "Narset", section "Searching for answers". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ugin refuses to help quell the dragonstorms; Jace's spell to recreate the Multiverse fails, unmaking reality and Jace, and the others escape.
timeline.quote: As it failed, it revealed a void that poured toward them, unmaking reality — Jace included.

citation.text: "Narset", section "Searching for answers". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jace arrives on Tarkir with Loot and Vraska and travels to the Meditation Realm to reshape the Multiverse.
timeline.quote: He intends to use the unique powers of the Meditation Realm to reshape the Multiverse

citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm", section "Storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Narset and Elspeth confront Jace in the Meditation Realm and he loses control of its powers.
timeline.quote: but is confronted there by Narset and Elspeth and loses control of those powers

citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm", section "Storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The conflict tips the balance between Ugin and Nicol Bolas; Bolas recovers his name and escapes, while Jace appears to become connected to the Meditation Realm.
timeline.quote: Bolas recovers his name and escapes, while Jace appears to become connected to the Meditation Realm.

citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm", section "Storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The new planeswalker sparks to the Meditation Realm, startling Ral Zarek and letting Vaash Vroga escape.
timeline.quote: Upon sparking to the Meditation Realm , the new planeswalker startled Ral Zarek who was nearby, allowing Vaash Vroga to catch him off-guard and escape.

citation.text: "The Traveler", section "The Meditation Realm". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ral becomes the planeswalker's mentor in exchange for help tracking Vaash.
timeline.quote: Ral took on the role of mentor and showed the planeswalker how to follow in Vaash's wake.

citation.text: "The Traveler", section "The Meditation Realm". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ajani recounts that Jace lost control of an unidentifiable spell in the Meditation Realm and dissolved into light and energy.
timeline.quote: The spell took him, and he was gone. Just light and energy on the wind.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 2: Shake Off Slumber
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 2: Shake Off Slumber" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: In the Meditation Realm, Jace learns to transform an illusion into something real.
timeline.quote: Using the magic of the Meditation Realm, Jace learned how to transform an illusion into something real.

citation.text: "The Legends of Reality Fracture" by Meris Mullaley, Christopher Stuart-Reckling, K. Arsenault Rivera, DK Billins. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: Jace's mind fractures after his apparent death in the Meditation Realm, and the Theorist takes over.
timeline.quote: Jace's mind fractured after his apparent death in the Meditation Realm.

citation.text: "The Legends of Reality Fracture" by Meris Mullaley, Christopher Stuart-Reckling, K. Arsenault Rivera, DK Billins. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: Jace's ritual in the Meditation Realm goes awry, consuming him and the Realm as Narset and Elspeth watch.
timeline.quote: That map led Jace to the Meditation Realm in Tarkir: Dragonstorm where Narset and Elspeth witnessed Jace conduct a ritual that went awry, consuming both Jace and the Realm.

citation.text: "Reality Fracture", section "Storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

pages_say.description: A mirrored, shifting realm of endless water and stairs where Narset has been before, appearing different to each viewer and meant to conceal something.

citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 5: Recursion" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Mar 2025.

citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 2: Shake Off Slumber" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Dec 2025.
